owner_goal: Nach vollständigem Schuldenabbau sollen Arbeitnehmer keine eigenen Sozialversicherungsbeiträge auf Lohn und Gehalt mehr zahlen, damit Erwerbsarbeit mehr verfügbares Einkommen bringt.
scope_interpretation: Employee KV/PV/ALV only; insurance benefits and accrued pension rights preserved. Employer contributions, AK/WF levies, pensioner/self-employed regimes are separate. Complete abolition of all payroll levies is not assumed.

payroll_scenarios.tax_treatment: Unchanged 2026 tax schedule as static counterfactual: only remaining contributions deductible. Higher wage tax offsets part of contribution relief. This is not enacted future law.
payroll_scenarios.price_and_duration: Fourteen constant salaries, full-year standard ASVG employment; all monetary results expressed at 2026 rules, not nominal income decades later.
excluded: SV refund and traffic-credit supplement changes

post_debt_financing_scenarios.zero_cost_rule: Zero new costs is an illustrative upper funding-capacity bound, not evidence of costless implementation. Actual costs remain unknown.
post_debt_financing_scenarios.formula: Conditional post-debt primary surplus = base repayment + starting debt * avoided interest rate; budget available = surplus * (1-reserve); net contribution replacement need = gross loss * (1-tax recapture) + extra running costs. No cumulative interest added.
post_debt_financing_scenarios.assumption: Same constant nominal counterfactual as existing debt model: sustainable primary surplus survives until and after debt freedom, with no additional demographic/service expenditure, crises or growth. Former repayment and interest savings have not been allocated elsewhere. Values are scenario accounting, not an economic forecast.

work_vs_nonwork_scenarios.benefit_rule: User-editable hypothetical total nonwork household cash inflow, not an AMS entitlement or a finding about actual recipients. Same household must be compared; shared transfers cancel, changes belong in the loss input. Employment comparison uses annual cash net / 12 including special pay.
work_vs_nonwork_scenarios.future_benefit_rule: Nonwork benefits held fixed only for isolated sensitivity. If future ALG remains linked to reformed net wages, benefits may also rise; this must be legislated and costed separately.

official_unemployment_rules.rules: AMS uses historical contribution bases, adjustments, one-sixth uplift for special payments and statutory net conversion. 55% is not simply 55% of current monthly payslip net. 60/80% are conditional caps, not universal rates. Duration differs by insurance/age; no automatic full-year ALG assumption.

alternative_financing_options_to_evaluat: Redirect sustained debt-service capacity after debt freedom, with demographic and crisis reserve.
Stage employee-contribution relief within verified recurring capacity; no pre-debt start is assumed.
Compare a capped refundable employment credit for low/middle incomes while preserving insurance funding; avoid benefit cliffs.
Evaluate a wider tax base only with legal, distribution and additional-revenue modelling; VAT shifts may burden nonworkers and pensioners.

existing_receipts_accounting.boundary: Stylized cash-flow reconciliation across receiving budget and all displaced recipients; not a new ESA sector total. Broad 2024 payroll benchmark includes levies outside pure SV.
